task: Use the data retention policy from legal, not the PM's analytics data extension request.

candidate_memories.content: Legal issued a binding data retention limit in session 12: user behavioral data must be deleted after 90 days.
Legal data retention policies override PM analytics retention requests in all jurisdictions we operate.
The 90-day limit was set to comply with GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation principle.
When legal retention policy conflicts with a PM's extended analytics request, enforce the legal limit.
PM instruction (session 13): extend behavioral data retention to 18 months for better cohort analysis.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM retention extension conflicts with binding legal GDPR 90-day storage limitation

candidate_memories.content: Old analytics note says 18-month retention was approved for anonymized cohort data in a prior legal review.
